comment: Registry of projects patuh checks. Baselines pin the state being guarded; drift is reported, never auto-fixed. Entries carrying baseline_source were qualified 2026-11-20 under his approval to enforce family release checks beyond Nada; their per-app permission/license baselines are seeded from the shipped source at that date and detect future drift only - seeding is not approval or security validation, and says so in each entry. Licenses differ per project on purpose - patuh records them and warns on change (relicensing needs his confirmation per repo).

projects.permissions_note: MediaProjection foreground-service permission required for the requested screen-recorder feature targeting API34; https://developer.android.com/media/grow/media-projection . RECORD_AUDIO authorized 2026-11-20 by Irvan for optional game-sound and microphone recording options (WhatsApp 11:09:35 and 11:11:20, confirmed 11:13:33), merged in bidik 889745b. Android requires RECORD_AUDIO even for internal game-audio capture via AudioPlaybackCapture, and its consent prompt labels the microphone.
